svg.title: Kachi — rally / selloff
svg.desc: Kachi: the pair rally / selloff set large, rally in blue and selloff in red. The trick: A rally is buyers pushing prices up; a selloff is sellers pushing them down. More pairs from the course: slump / rebound, beat / miss, revenue / earnings, coupon / yield, hawkish / dovish, capex / opex, in-sample / out-of-sample, hedge / pledge. 6 levels, 238 concepts, 145 confusion pairs, 125 lessons, 1,697 prompts.
